stage1.impression: A moody backlit forest with real atmosphere: the warm haze, the shafts on the left and the dark speaker against the glow give it a clear idea and a credible sunrise palette. But it still reads as CG: the mid trunks are smooth tapered columns with no bark, the haze behind the speaker is a flat beige wash, and the bottom sixth of the frame is a dead, uniformly dark slab with a ruler-straight shadow edge. The speaker reads as a near-black box whose rim light only works on its right edge; no warm light passes through the tint.

blocking_9: Every trunk in focus range shows resolved bark relief (furrows, plates) with no smooth column surfaces
The foreground reads as dappled pine litter with trunk shadows streaking toward camera, not a single uniform dark band with a straight edge
The speaker is rimmed on both vertical edges and its top edge in warm light, and the tinted acrylic shows amber transmission at its edges
The smoke wall separates into distinct shafts across the whole width, not only at the far left
No photo-background blotches or flat-card trees visible through the haze
Shadows carry a slight cool counterpoint so the frame is not a single sepia monochrome

defects.what: mid trunk is a smooth tapered column with no bark texture (lum_range 32.8 in a 50 px strip)
left mid trunk equally smooth; its base dissolves into a soft blob in the ground haze
right close trunk has low bark contrast and no branch stubs visible; reads as a dark column
foreground is a uniform dark band (lum median 31.9) with a straight full-width shadow edge, like a wall's shadow off frame
speaker's left edge carries almost no rim (p95 121 vs 230 on the right edge)
speaker body is a flat near-black (median 25) with no light passing through the tint; front face reads as grey plastic
blotchy, low-resolution leafy texture from the background photo visible through the haze
smoke wall behind right half is a flat wash without shafts
ground-to-haze transition is a soft, featureless band; no mid-ground detail between 2 and 8 m
horn's back panel is a near-white blank reflection of the haze, losing its form

changes.problem: The foreground bottom sixth is a dead uniform shadow with a straight full-width edge that no forest would cast.

evidence.measured: lum_median 31.9, lum_range 49.7; y-profile of 640-800 flat at 30-32 after the step; edge at x 600 steps -22 over 36 px, straight across the frame

change.setting: Canopy layer at 10 m (and sun elevation)
change.to: 75 % open, clumps 0.5 m; sun elevation 16 so the trunks' shadows streak toward the camera across the foreground

changes.expected: Foreground broken into alternating lit litter and long trunk-shadow stripes; median rises to about 40-50 with much more local range.

changes.problem: The trunks read as smooth CG columns; the bark bump does not resolve at this distance through the haze.

evidence.measured: lum_range 32.8, p5 51.8 / p95 84.6 across a trunk strip, i.e. almost no texture; close right trunk 1050-1120 lum_range 48.5

change.to: true displacement 0.025 m on trunks within 6 m of the speaker, bark texture scale x0.6 (larger plates), tint 15 %, roughness variation on the plates

changes.expected: Visible furrowed plates catching the side light on the near and mid trunks; strip luminance range at least doubles.

changes.problem: The silhouette is rimmed only on the right; the left and top edges die into the body, so the shape does not read at a glance.

evidence.measured: left edge p95 121 against right edge (530-538) p95 230; top edge 330-540 x 345-360 median 32.5

change.to: 0.5 x 2.8 m, elevation 30, irradiance 75, raised to also graze the cabinet top

changes.expected: A continuous warm line on the left vertical edge and along the cabinet top, matching the right edge.

changes.problem: The smoked acrylic shows no light passing through it; the body is a flat near-black box and the front face reads as grey plastic.

evidence.measured: lum_median 25, p95 50.9, r/g/b 28/24/23 (neutral, no amber transmission)

change.to: a 1.2 x 1.6 m area light 1.5 m directly behind the speaker (azimuth 160, elevation 10), #FFB978, irradiance 20, speaker only, so the tint glows at its thin edges and between the lining panels

changes.expected: Warm amber glow at the acrylic edges and gaps, body median lifting slightly with a warmer cast while it still reads as a dark silhouette.

changes.problem: The smoke wall behind the right half is a flat wash; shafts only separate at the far left, so the 'glowing wall cut into shafts' idea is half delivered.

evidence.measured: x-profile at y 200-260 flat at 153-180 across the clearing; region lum_p5 81 driven only by trunks

change.to: density 0.10, cut 0.5, soft 0.15 (more contrast between smoke and clear air so the canopy's shafts read)

changes.expected: Distinct diagonal shafts across the full width with darker clear-air gaps between them.

changes.problem: The background photo shows through the haze as blotchy low-resolution leafy patches and flat-card trunks.

evidence.measured: visible mottled leaf texture in the crop; lum_range 57 in a region that should be smooth smoke

change.to: misty_pines strength 0.08 and add 8 more modelled trunks between 14 and 25 m so the depth comes from geometry under the smoke rather than the photo

changes.expected: Background becomes smoke with receding real trunks; no photo mottling.

changes.problem: The ground between the speaker and the haze is featureless, giving no scale cues and no contact story around the feet.

evidence.measured: y-profile 430-530 a smooth monotone ramp 80 to 59 with no structure

change.to: add pine cones and needle clumps scattered 0.5-4 m around the speaker, one surface root crossing the ground 2 m behind, and one low fallen branch at 1.5 m left-front

changes.expected: Scale and depth cues in the mid-ground; the speaker sits in a place rather than on a plane.

changes.problem: The frame is a single sepia monochrome; shadows carry no cool counterpoint, which reads as a colour filter rather than dawn light.

evidence.measured: r/g/b median 47/29/16 in the shadows; haze 196/157/124

changes.expected: Shadows go slightly neutral-cool while the haze stays warm; the speaker's front picks up a faint cool fill.

out_of_scope.request: Reduce the near-white blank reflection on the horn's rear panel (400-545, 222-335, p95 227)
out_of_scope.why: It is the horn's own glossy surface reflecting the haze; changing the finish would change the speaker. It can only be shaped indirectly by what the horn sees.
